test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is the main reason for classifying economic activities into different sectors in India?

options.text: To understand their functioning and interdependence
To reduce employment in capital-intensive sectors

solution:
The Correct answer is __**To understand their functioning and interdependence**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Classifying **economic activities** into different sectors helps in understanding the **structure of an economy**.
 
• The three main sectors of economic activities are the **primary sector** (agriculture and natural resources), the **secondary sector** (manufacturing and industry), and the **tertiary sector** (services).
